content: Phexroosi Paththida Toho Sila Addeza
Issi wode gallassafe uddufun saate bolla Phexroosinne Yohannisi woosa saaten Xoossa Keeththe baana kezida.
Issi yelettoosoppe doommidi tohoy silidaade Xoossa Keeththe geliza asappe miishshe woossana mala asay gallas gallas tookki efidi woththiin, «Lo7o» geetettiza Xoossa Keeththa pengen woossizaadey dees.
Izikka Phexroosinne Yohannisi Xoossa Keeththe gelishin be7idi isttafe miishshe woossides.
Phexroosinne Yohannisi iza tishshi histti xeellida. Phexroosikka iza, «Ane haa nuna xeella» gides.
Addezikka isttafe aykko demmana giidi istta tishshi histti xeellides.
Gido attiin Phexroosi izas zaaridi, «Taas biraynne worqqay deenna; gidikkoka taas dizaaz ta nees immays; Naazirete Yesus Kirstoosa sunththan dendada ne tohora hemetta» gides.
Izas ushachcha kushe oykkidi denththides. Heerakka addeza tohoynne toho qirphey minnides.
Guppi dendi eqqidi hemeth oykkides. Yaanne haa hemettishenne guppishe Xoossaka galatishe isttara issife Xoossa Keeththa gibbe gelides.
Izi Xoossa galatishe yaanne haa simerettishin asay be7ides.
Hayssaadey hayssafe kase, «Lo7o» geetettiza Xoossa Keeththa pengen uttidi miishshe woossizay iza gididayssa erides. Iza bolla hanidayssafe dendidayssan asay keehi malalettides.
Phexroosa Haasaya
Ha paxida woosanchchay Phexroosakkonne Yohannisakko shiphphi giidi isttara oyketti dishin derey wuri malalettidi isttako, «Solomoone simereteththaso» geetettizaso woththan yides.

Phexroosi he asaa be7idi, «Intteno Isra7eele deretoo! Hayssan aazas malaletteetii? Qasseka hayssa addeza nuni nu wolqqan woykko nuni nu xilloteththan paththidi hemettissida mala qoodidi nuna aazas tishshi histti xeelleetii?
Nu aawantta Abrahaamentta, Yisaaqantta, Yaaqoobentta Xoossi ba naaza Yesusa bonchchides. Intte qasse iza hayqos aaththi immideta; Philaxoosi iza birshana koyiinkka intte, ‹Koyokko› gideta.
Geeshshanne xilloza intte kaddidi shempo wodhizayssi birshettana mala woossideta.
De7o immizaade intte wodhideta; gido attiin Xoossi iza hayqoppe denththides; hessas nuni markka.

Hayssi intte be7izayssinne intte erizayssi minni eqqiday Yesusa sunththan ammanida gishshassa; intte wurikka be7iza mala izi kumeththa paxateth demmiday Yesusa sunththaninne iza sunththan beettiza ammanonna.
«Ha7ikka ta ishatoo! Intte hessa ooththiday intte halaqata mala erontta gididayssa ta erays.
Gidikkoka Kirstoosi waaye ekkanayssa Xoossi kase nabeta doonan haasaydayssa polides.
Hessa gishshas intte nagaray qucetti dhayana mala maaroteththan gelite; intte biza ogeppe simmite; Godaa matappe intte ooraxana wodey inttes yaana.
Qasseka Xoossi kase inttes doori woththida Yesus Kirstoosa izi inttes yeddana.
Xoossi kase geeshsha nabeta doonan haasaydayssa mala hanizayssa ubbaa ooraxissana wodey gakkanaas izi salon gam7anaas koshshees.
Museykka, ‹Intte Godaa Xoossay intte giddofe ta mala nabe inttes denththana. Izi inttes yootizayssa siyite.
He nabeza siyontta ixxida shemppoy wuri dere giddofe shaaketti dhayo.›
«Tumappe Sameelappe haa simmiin dendida nabeti wuri hayta wodeta gishshas haasayda.
Intteka nabeta nayta; qasseka Xoossi Abrahaames, ‹Ne zereththan biitta bolla diza asi wuri anjjettana› giidi izi caaqqida caaqoza intte laattana.
Xoossi naaza denththida wode inttena issaa issaa intte iitateththaafe zaaridi anjjana mala kasetidi intteko kiittides» gides.
